answers.q2: The function is `unescapeHtml`, exported as a property of the default export: `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml`. `escapeHtml` stays the default export.
answers.q3: `'` is matched by the decimal numeric branch of the regex. `parseInt` gives 39 and `String.fromCharCode` turns it into `'`.
answers.q4: Code points above 0x10FFFF and surrogates in 0xD800–0xDFFF are left untouched. The original entity text is returned unchanged.
answers.q5: It builds a surrogate pair by hand rather than using `String.fromCodePoint`, with high surrogate 0xD800+(cp>>10) and low surrogate 0xDC00+(cp&0x3FF). `😀` becomes 😀.
answers.q6: It asserts that a single pass decodes only one layer, so `&lt;` becomes `<` and not `<`.
answers.q7: The material names `©`, `&` and `&constructor;` as staying unchanged for that test. It also lists `'` among unknown names, though it doesn't say which test case holds it.
answers.q8: `npm test` failed with exit code 127 and the message `sh: 1: mocha: not found`.
answers.q9: `npm test` couldn't run because mocha wasn't installed, so the agent ran `test/index.js` with `describe`/`it` mapped to node:test as globals. All 30 existing tests passed with 0 failed.
answers.q10: unknown. The material shows the edits and then the tests passing with 10 tests, but gives no count of edit rounds or any failed test run before it.
